reported_failure: The fixture returned the canonical workspace root validation error before comparing the sweep with its pairwise oracle.
diagnosis: The test constructs child paths from TempDir.path and passes those paths directly to WorkspaceBinding.new. On Windows the physical canonical path has a verbatim prefix. WorkspaceBinding requires the caller to supply its canonical path. This is a fixture contract violation, not evidence of a failed sweep algorithm.

change.behavior: Canonicalize each created physical directory before constructing its workspace binding.

scope: This change does not address the separate Windows native linker diagnostics or claim that all Windows jobs pass. Frozen R13 numerical runtime and outcomes are unchanged.
